lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct, high-contrast vertical white lines are visible traversing the torso, spaced approximately 40 to 60 pixels apart with higher density in the mid-torso section.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Multiple line segments terminate abruptly at the lower torso due to occlusion by the foreground log; several lines show fading or dashed characteristics as they approach the dorsal mane.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A low-density grouping of approximately 5 distinct white spots is visible on the upper posterior haunch area above the line of occlusion.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns follow a spiral lyrate trajectory, originating at a 75-degree upward angle from the skull before curving laterally and then converging slightly at the tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The estimated distance between the terminal tips is approximately 1.3 times the combined horizontal width of the horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The bright ivory-colored terminal tips comprise approximately 15% of the total visible horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of three red-billed oxpeckers (Buphagus erythrorhynchus) on and near the body; three distinct white spots located on the cheek/jaw area and two white spots on the nasal bridge.
